scenes.title: Breakout
scenes.caption: Your history is the level.
scenes.description: One ball to begin. A long streak brings a second, then a third. A gentle start, a little more momentum, and your year begins again.

scenes.title: Growing Snake
scenes.caption: Small steps. A little growth.
scenes.description: Start with the smallest contribution counts and plan a path upward. Grow once every 5 dates, with a compact 16-segment limit.

scenes.title: Pac-Man
scenes.caption: Date pellets, hungry turns, and ghosts on your trail.
scenes.description: The original contribution dates stay fixed at their actual week and weekday coordinates. Pac-Man follows planned adjacent routes to eat lower contribution counts first. Actual consecutive-day streaks increase his pace, and three ghosts pursue the same connected calendar trail.

scenes.title: Tetris
scenes.caption: Legal pieces fall through the original seven-row calendar.
scenes.description: Active dates supply legal tetrominoes, with lower contribution counts first. The board has the original calendar width and seven weekday rows. Missing dates are unavailable. Pieces collide with the stack, full weekday lines clear, and cleared calendar tiles disappear with the piece outlines. If no legal piece fits, the calendar rests.

scenes.title: Garden
scenes.caption: Small habits, a living garden.
scenes.description: Each active date grows a plant. Exact contribution counts control its height, leaves and flowering, while the recorded months bring seasonal colors. Public repository languages shape the aggregate planting blend when supplied.

scenes.title: City
scenes.caption: A skyline raised one week at a time.
scenes.description: Each active week develops from a foundation through a structural frame to a finished building. Its exact weekly contribution total controls skyline height; quiet weeks leave a gap.

scenes.title: Space Invaders
scenes.caption: A quiet sky. A very busy defense.
scenes.description: The ship fires at real contribution dates in ascending count order. Invaders disappear only on projectile impact. A streak of seven consecutive active dates unlocks a boss.

scenes.title: Train
scenes.caption: Every week, another little station.
scenes.description: A train follows the weeks chronologically, stopping only at stations with actual contributions. Landscape seasons follow calendar months in the northern hemisphere.

scenes.title: Civilization
scenes.caption: From a first camp to a distant orbit.
scenes.description: Actual accumulated contributions cross fixed era thresholds, growing a camp into a hamlet, village, town, industrial settlement and spaceport. Observed inactive runs weather and overgrow the settlement; activity repairs it. Reaching Space unlocks a rocket launch after the complete year: ignition, accelerating liftoff and a flight beyond the card.

scenes.title: Archaeology
scenes.caption: A small pickaxe. A year of buried treasure.
scenes.description: The miner excavates real dates in ascending contribution-count order. Counts set quartz, copper, gold and diamond tiers. Excavating a consecutive five-day streak reveals a treasure chest.

scenes.title: Game of Life
scenes.caption: A year becomes a living pattern.
scenes.description: Active dates seed a finite Conway world. Every next generation follows B3/S23: births at three neighbors, survival at two or three.

scenes.title: Ant Colony
scenes.caption: Small journeys, a shared store.
scenes.description: Three workers collect the smallest contribution deposits first and carry each harvest home. Resource totals change only when a worker reaches the nest.

scenes.title: Weather Report
scenes.caption: Every season has its own pace.
scenes.description: Quiet weeks bring rain, active runs open the sky, and a new weekly peak scatters a small celebration. Every weather change follows your calendar.

scenes.title: Dungeon
scenes.caption: Light a room. Find the next door.
scenes.description: Dates keep their calendar rooms. The hero plans adjacent routes to collect the smallest remaining contribution counts first; larger rooms stay dormant until their turn. Collected activity defeats a final guardian.

scenes.title: Year in Rhythm
scenes.caption: A quiet score, written by your year.
scenes.description: Weeks become beats. Actual contribution totals set each note height and pulse; active days retain their date order in each beat. This visual score is silent.

scenes.title: Space Route
scenes.caption: One small ship. A constellation of weeks.
scenes.description: Every week is a planet. The ship docks at active weeks in chronological order and flies past intervening quiet planets. Each actual contribution adds one fuel; each station-to-station jump spends one fuel.

scenes.title: Town
scenes.caption: A neighborhood made by showing up.
scenes.description: Contributions fund homes and connecting lanes. Active weeks earn festivals. When real public activity context is available, the civic square reports observed sampled commits, issues, pull requests and reviews without inventing daily attribution.

scenes.title: Match Three
scenes.caption: Swap real dates into runs. Let the cascades follow.
scenes.description: Every active date starts in its original week and weekday slot, colored by its real GitHub intensity. Existing runs resolve first. Legal adjacent swaps prefer the lowest available match total; matched dates bank their actual counts and surviving gems fall within real date slots. Missing dates block gravity. All dates start on the graph, so there are no reserves or fabricated refills; forced cascades may match larger counts.

scenes.title: Whack-a-Mole
scenes.caption: Moles pop on their original dates. Streaks sharpen your timing.
scenes.description: One mole appears on every actual active date at its original week and weekday coordinates, with lower counts first. Higher contribution counts shorten the pop window, while real daily streaks reduce hammer reaction time. The hammer travels to that date and banks its contributions only before the mole hides. Zero-count date tiles stay visible, and missing dates are absent.
